parsed.rationale: Two separate packages — 'Metadata' and 'app:iOS' — each define a type-alias named 'MockDiscogsEntityResolver' (at line 29 in 'Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift' and line 25 in 'WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift' respectively). Because both are type-alias-objects with empty field lists and both relate to Discogs entity resolution, the alias in the app:iOS test target is almost certainly a copy of the one already present in the Metadata package's test support. Consolidating the canonical definition in the Metadata package and having the app:iOS test target import it eliminates the name collision and keeps the mock in the package that owns the Discogs domain types. Neither record carries is_test=true in its context flags, but both live under test file paths, so the duplication is accidental rather than intentional fixture isolation.
